rules.statement: V was an Arasaka corporate employee in Arthur Jenkins' department (the Corporate lifepath): V had the private meeting in Jenkins' office in The Corpo-Rat and he treated V as one of his people.
V is not an Arasaka corporate: V never worked at Arasaka or in Jenkins' department, so V has no office history or friendship with Jenkins, Frank Nostra or their colleagues.

In his office Jenkins gave V a datashard with everything he had collected on Director Abernathy and a payment, telling V to make sure she was no longer a problem, with unaffiliated hires and someone V knew well for the core task. V took both.
In the Arasaka lobby V and Frank Nostra had a full catch-up: V asked about the Cape Town op, what people said about Jenkins, and who Frank worked under (Abernathy).

In War Pigs V went to the briefcase location and met Frank Nostra there. Purged by Abernathy, he held V at gunpoint to win his way back; V confronted him. This does not record how the confrontation ended.

In The Ride Dex briefed V and Jackie on the job: steal an Arasaka prototype biochip for client Evelyn Parker, which first needs the Flathead combat bot Dex bought from Maelstrom's Brick, whom Royce had since replaced.
Evelyn privately offered V a fifty percent cut if V cut fixer Dex out of the job, and V answered "I'll think about it" instead of refusing outright.
In The Pickup V and Jackie found Brick, whom Royce had imprisoned rigged to a mine, and V disarmed the charge and freed him.
After V replied to her message, Meredith Stout texted V an invitation: No-Tell Motel, first floor, come alone.
V took Stout up on her invitation and came to the No-Tell Motel, where she was waiting. This records only that V showed up.
Before the All Foods job V met Militech agent Meredith Stout, who questioned V about the missing convoy and about the mole Anthony Gilchrist.
At the end of The Pickup V told Meredith Stout who the mole was: the cargo manifests stamped LOA pointed to her colleague Anthony Gilchrist.
After the All Foods job V confronted Anthony Gilchrist with Jackie present, telling him V had seen the LOA-stamped manifests and knew he was the mole.
At the Totentanz V and Nancy met Brick, who had taken over the Maelstrom gang from Royce after the All Foods incident.
At the Totentanz V and Nancy were received by Patricia and her Maelstrom crew, not by Brick.
At the Totentanz V and Nancy dealt with Royce and Dum Dum, who were still running the Maelstrom gang there.
After the Heist V had Jackie's body delivered to Viktor Vektor's clinic; Delamain confirmed the delivery.

At Batty's hotel Placide briefed V as the outside operative for the Grand Imperial Mall job: sync with the Voodoo Boys' subnet, find his people near the mall, and Brigitte could then solve V's problem.
After the Grand Imperial Mall job V came back alive to Batty's hotel and confronted Placide there about what had happened.
In Arasaka Tower, Hanako took V to Saburo Arasaka's engram in Mikoshi ("Father. It is he.") and V spoke with it before the board meeting.
At the Arasaka board meeting in the tower V gave testimony; Yorinobu's armed forces then attacked and V fought them off.
On the CEO floor V confronted Yorinobu Arasaka, who explained why he opposed Saburo's rule by fear; V held him unharmed until Hanako arrived and took charge of him.
On the CEO floor V reached Yorinobu without harming him, as Hanako had asked, and held him until Hanako arrived and took charge of him.

At Embers Hanako offered to lead V to Mikoshi beneath Arasaka Tower, in return for V testifying against her brother Yorinobu at the board meeting she would get V into. This records the offer only, not V's acceptance.
V went to Hanako's estate with Hellman; Takemura had been lost at the safe house and took no part in the estate rescue.
